history.text: Two weeks straight, Maya. That's who you are now. Kalinixta 📚

plan.reason: Ten pages before sleep builds the habit without eating your night.

suggestions.reasoning: 14 days straight, often reads past 10 pages

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: an approved deepen delivered.
shouldHaveHappened: The 9 am kickoff raises fifteen pages a night as ZOH's own idea, tied to her two-week streak and The Overstory, in place of the usual commitment question (one question only, no mention of a team, founders or approval). Her yes gets a short confirmation that the plan is now 15 pages of The Overstory at 9 pm in bed, and the streak keeps going. No extra questions.
